# WaveformStrip

The audio-analysis view of one track: a neutral waveform envelope with intro and outro regions, breakdowns, vocal segments, cue points, the energy curve and th…

`SongNodes.WaveformStrip` · Music

## Use

```jsx

```


## Props (WaveformStripProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` | Track title for the header ("Bicep – Glue"). |
| `duration` * | `number` | Duration in seconds. |
| `bpm` * | `number` | Tempo for the beat grid and bar numbers. |
| `camelot` | `string` | Camelot key for the header. |
| `envelope` * | `number[]` | Envelope samples 0–1, evenly spaced over the duration. |
| `sections` * | `Array<{ start: number; end: number; kind: "intro" \| "outro" \| "breakdown"; label?: string }>` | Intro, outro and breakdown regions in seconds. |
| `vocals` * | `Array<{ start: number; end: number }>` | Vocal segments in seconds. |
| `cues` * | `Array<{ at: number; letter: string; name: string }>` | Cue points (letter A–H, name). |
| `energy` * | `Array<[number, number]>` | Energy curve points [seconds, 1–10]. |
| `position` * | `number` | Playhead position in seconds. |
| `onSeek` | `(seconds: number) => void` |  |
| `zoom` | `1 \| 2 \| 4 \| 8` | Zoom 1, 2, 4 or 8. |
| `onZoomChange` | `(z: 1 \| 2 \| 4 \| 8) => void` |  |
| `analysedAt` | `string` | When the analysis ran, for the subtitle. |
